_about: Cardio days (Javier, 18 Oct 2026): conditioning routines OUTSIDE Francesco's plan, picked from the menu. Hand-written, not from TrueCoach. scripts/build_freeco.py validates this file and writes it into data/programme.js as PROGRAMME.cardio (and its new movements into PROGRAMME.exercises). Every routine is: Stairmaster warm-up (Zone 2) → the WOD (mostly Zone 3, short Zone 4 spikes) → easy cooldown → optional core, run on the clock (a 'circuit': four holds were too tall for one round screen with a timer button each). Each is named after a football legend; the WODs themselves go by no name in the app (Javier, 24 Oct 2026: “no need for it”) — only their format, the original text and the source link. 'wod.original' is the workout as published (or as Javier did it), verbatim; 'wod.changes' says what this version changes and why — the app shows both. Steve came from Javier; the others are CrossFit benchmark workouts, adapted to a controlled Zone 3 day, no running (Javier: 'just bike or rowing').

warmup.name: Warm-up
warmup.note: Easy, steady climb — you can still talk in full sentences.

cooldown.name: Cooldown
cooldown.note: Easy bike or rower, then stretch calves, hips and shoulders.

core.name: Core
core.note: Each hold on the clock, 10 sec to switch between them.

wod.original: AMRAP 4 min × 4: 8 squat snatches, 16/12 cal Echo bike, AMRAP burpees to target. 2 min rest.

block.name: WOD
block.note: Each set: the snatches and the bike, then burpees until the 4 minutes are up.

wod.original: 5 rounds for time: run 400 meters, 30 box jumps (24 / 20 in.), 30 wall ball shots (20 / 14 lb.).
wod.changes: Row instead of run, 4 rounds not for time, 20 + 20 reps, step down from the box — Zone 3, and easier on the Achilles after a strength day.

wod.original: For time: 150 wall-ball shots (20-lb ball to 10 ft / 14-lb ball to 9 ft).
wod.changes: Spread over a 30-minute EMOM: the same 150 wall balls on the odd minutes, lateral footwork on the even ones.

block.name: WOD
block.note: Start each minute on the beep; rest for whatever is left of it.

wod.original: 3 rounds for max reps of: 1 minute of wall-ball shots, 1 minute of sumo deadlift high pulls, 1 minute of box jumps, 1 minute of push presses, 1 minute of rowing (calories), rest 1 minute.
wod.changes: 5 rounds at a steady 70% instead of 3 for max reps; kettlebell swings instead of the barbell high pull; light barbell push press; step down from the box.

wod.original: AMRAP in 20 minutes: 10 push presses, 10 kettlebell swings, 10 box jumps (115-lb / 75-lb barbell, 1.5 / 1 pood kettlebell, 24 / 20 in. box).
wod.changes: 30 minutes instead of 20, a lighter bar, step down from the box — keep moving at a steady pace, no rests.

wod.original: 3 rounds for time of: run 800 meters, 50 back extensions, 50 sit-ups.
wod.changes: Row instead of run, 25 + 25 reps, not for time — the low-jump day, for after heavy legs.
